blocking_gaps: No structured shot-level execution record binds PromptIR, GenerationPayload, ModelProfile, provider request/response, and Media Candidate.
TaskRun.payload and VisualReferenceAsset.generation_provenance are generic JSON fields and cannot be used as the canonical Phase F authority.
No persisted uniqueness/serialization rule prevents concurrent duplicate provider calls for one request fingerprint.
The existing creative task boundary accepts free-form prompt/reference inputs and performs automatic storyboard/reference projections.
The existing image recovery path and async transports contain retry behavior that is incompatible with the one-call Canary contract.
